name: rules-rtdb-r12-claims-and-server-time
description: RTDB rules production verdicts for corpus scenario "r12-claims-and-server-time" (rtdb#71). Captured by deploy-observe-restore (RTDB has no server-side rules test API). auth.token claims and the server-time binding `now` decide a real append-only log: the provider claim the anonymous session carries grants the read, the email_verified and admin claims it lacks deny two others, a future timestamp is rejected against now, and an existing entry cannot be overwritten.
